author: Benke Holgersson
text: I use Libre3+ and the sensor works greate, no problems. The Libre 3 app is not as good as Dexcom in many ways but I dont like dexcom sensors that show strange numbers any needs calibration.

author: Brian Hawken
text: We use Libre 2+ and have had great experience past 2 yrs.  Have had minimal failures, find it accurate and appreciate the extra day of wear.  That said, everyone is different and may have different experiences with each - adhesion (skin types vary), connection with apps or readers, etc.  Best of luck!
